occurrences.checkable_against: the joint DOJ-FBI statement
occurrences.quote_span: “Under President Trump, the Department of Justice will continue to vigorously uphold the First Amendment rights of all Americans and restore the rule of law. The DOJ and FBI have a responsibility to investigate any potential violations of federal law, and conspiracies to impede federal law enforcement and assaults on federal officers are against the law. Violence is not protected by the First Amendment. Politically motivated attacks will not deter us from doing our job,” the statement said.

Fields ultimately resigned from the bureau last year.
